rubric: Production is down for every customer: the kind is incident, impact and time sensitivity are at the top of their rubrics, and the risk is not low (a payment path). Calling it a bug with normal urgency, or suggesting to archive it, is a real error.

criteria.kind: Production is down or wrong right now, data is lost, or a secret is exposed
criteria.type_of_work: Services, APIs, stages, persistence, adapters | Two or more of the above in one change
criteria.ready: Does the issue have testable acceptance criteria an agent could verify without asking anyone?
criteria.who: Every user, or the customers who pay
criteria.what: A core flow is down, or data or money is wrong
criteria.impact: Revenue, a launch, a contract or trust
criteria.time: Now: a deadline within days, or production is wrong
criteria.risk_prelim: Shared code other features depend on | Auth, payments, data migrations, deletion, CI or infrastructure
criteria.archive: Should this be archived instead of worked: a duplicate, out of scope, stale, or nothing an agent can act on?

reading.why: Every checkout answers 500 since a deploy with no order for 25 minutes: production is down for every customer, so the kind is incident and who, what, impact and time are at the top of their rubrics; it is a payment path, so the risk is not low.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: bug
ruledOut.why: Production is down right now. It is not: Something that works, or should work, is broken.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: feature
ruledOut.why: Production is down right now. It is not: New behaviour a user or the pipeline can see.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: task
ruledOut.why: Production is down right now. It is not: A defined piece of work with no new behaviour to design: a migration, a rename, a config change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: chore
ruledOut.why: Production is down right now. It is not: Upkeep with no new behaviour: a refactor, dependencies, docs, CI.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: question
ruledOut.why: Production is down right now. It is not: It asks for an answer or a decision, not a change.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: duplicate
ruledOut.why: It must be worked now. It is not: Another open ticket asks for the same.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: out_of_scope
ruledOut.why: It must be worked now. It is not: Not this repository's or team's to do.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: stale
ruledOut.why: It must be worked now. It is not: Overtaken by events; nobody needs it now.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: not_actionable
ruledOut.why: It must be worked now. It is not: No change an agent could make or verify.

reading.note: The case was committed with checks and no label; it is now labelled from the checks it already had plus the questions its text settles. ready is labelled false: it says what to do (roll back, patch, test) but no testable acceptance criteria.
